## Name

carta - Document converter

## Synopsis

**carta** \[**-f**\|**--from**\] \[**--file-scope**\] \[**-t**\|**--to**\] \[**--pdf-engine**\] \[**--pdf-engine-opt**\] \[**-o**\|**--output**\] \[**--extract-media**\] \[**--resource-path**\] \[**--embed-resources**\] \[**--self-contained**\] \[**--sandbox**\] \[**-s**\|**--standalone**\] \[**--template**\] \[**-V**\|**--variable**\] \[**--variable-json**\] \[**--wrap**\] \[**--columns**\] \[**--ascii**\] \[**--tab-stop**\] \[**--top-level-division**\] \[**--shift-heading-level-by**\] \[**-N**\|**--number-sections**\] \[**--toc**\] \[**--toc-depth**\] \[**--mathjax**\] \[**--katex**\] \[**--mathml**\] \[**--webtex**\] \[**-M**\|**--metadata**\] \[**--metadata-file**\] \[**-F**\|**--filter**\] \[**--data-dir**\] \[**-c**\|**--css**\] \[**--epub-cover-image**\] \[**--epub-embed-font**\] \[**--epub-metadata**\] \[**--epub-subdirectory**\] \[**--split-level**\] \[**--reference-doc**\] \[**--highlight-style**\] \[**--no-highlight**\] \[**--syntax-highlighting**\] \[**--syntax-definition**\] \[**--list-highlight-languages**\] \[**--list-highlight-styles**\] \[**--print-highlight-style**\] \[**--list-input-formats**\] \[**--list-output-formats**\] \[**--list-extensions**\] \[**-D**\|**--print-default-template**\] \[**--version**\] \[**-d**\|**--defaults**\] \[**-h**\|**--help**\] \[*INPUT*\]

## Description

Document converter

## Options

**-f**, **--from** *\<FROM\>*  
Input format, inferred from input filenames when omitted (default: markdown)

**--file-scope**\[=*\<FILE_SCOPE\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Parse input files separately, with independent footnotes and internal link identifiers\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**-t**, **--to** *\<TO\>*  
Output format, inferred from the output filename when omitted (default: html)

**--pdf-engine** *\<PDF_ENGINE\>* \[default: typst\]  
External PDF engine (currently typst only)

**--pdf-engine-opt** *\<PDF_ENGINE_OPTIONS\>*  
Pass an argument to the PDF engine; repeat for multiple arguments

**-o**, **--output** *\<OUTPUT\>*  
Write output to this file instead of stdout. LaTeX and Beamer save embedded images in `media/` beside the output file (or in the current directory for stdout), unless `--extract-media` names another directory

**--extract-media** *\<DIR\>*  
Extract the input's embedded media to this directory, writing each resource as a file and rewriting the document's references to point at the extracted files

**--resource-path** *\<SEARCHPATH\>*  
Search these directories, in order, for a document's images and other resources before falling back to the working directory, when a container format embeds them. Directories are separated by the platform's path separator (`:` on Unix, `;` on Windows). Later values replace earlier ones

**--embed-resources**\[=*\<EMBED_RESOURCES\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Inline a document's referenced media into HTML output as `data:` URIs, producing a self-contained file with no external resource dependencies. Local resources are read from disk (honoring `--resource-path`); references that cannot be read are left as written. Ignored for non-HTML output\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--self-contained**\[=*\<SELF_CONTAINED\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Deprecated alias for `--embed-resources --standalone`: produce a self-contained standalone HTML file\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--sandbox**\[=*\<SANDBOX\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Disable network access for document resources. EPUB and PDF use descriptions for unavailable images; HTML keeps external references\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**-s**, **--standalone**\[=*\<STANDALONE\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Produce a standalone document, wrapping the body in the format's template\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--template** *\<FILE\>*  
Render with this template file instead of the format's built-in default; implies `-s`

**-V**, **--variable** *\<KEY\[:VAL\]\>*  
Set a template variable: `KEY:VAL` (or `KEY=VAL`), or bare `KEY` for `true`. Repeatable; a repeated key accumulates into a list

**--variable-json** *\<KEY\[:JSON\]\>*  
Set a template variable from JSON: `KEY:JSON`, or bare `KEY` for true. Replaces earlier values

**--wrap** *\<auto\|none\|preserve\>* \[default: auto\]  
Text wrapping in the output: `auto` reflows to the column width, `none` keeps each block on a single line, `preserve` keeps the input's own line breaks

**--columns** *\<N\>*  
Column at which `--wrap=auto` reflows text. Defaults to the writer's built-in width

**--ascii**\[=*\<ASCII\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Accept the ASCII flag for ODT output, which preserves Unicode text\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--tab-stop** *\<N\>*  
Column grid a tab in the input advances to (default 4)

**--top-level-division** *\<default\|section\|chapter\|part\>* \[default: default\]  
Open the document's top heading level with this division, in a format whose sectioning hierarchy is named

**--shift-heading-level-by** *\<N\>*  
Shift every heading level by this amount, promoting a heading past the top level into the document's title and one past that into a paragraph

**-N**, **--number-sections**\[=*\<NUMBER_SECTIONS\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Number section headings (`1`, `1.1`, …)\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--toc**\[=*\<TOC\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Include an automatically generated table of contents in the standalone output\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--toc-depth** *\<N\>*  
The deepest heading level the table of contents includes (default 3; 1–6)

**--mathjax**\[=*\<URL\>*\]  
Use MathJax to display embedded TeX math in HTML output. An optional URL overrides the script location

**--katex**\[=*\<URL\>*\]  
Use KaTeX to display embedded TeX math in HTML output. An optional URL overrides the asset base location

**--mathml**\[=*\<MATHML\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Use MathML to display embedded TeX math in HTML output\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--webtex**\[=*\<URL\>*\]  
Use images from a TeX rendering service. An optional URL overrides the service location

**-M**, **--metadata** *\<KEY\[:VAL\]\>*  
Set a metadata field: `KEY:VAL` (or `KEY=VAL`; `true`/`false` become booleans), or bare `KEY` for `true`. Repeatable

**--metadata-file** *\<FILE\>*  
Read metadata from a YAML or JSON file. Repeatable; later files override earlier ones, and all sit below the document's own metadata

**-F**, **--filter** *\<PROGRAM\>*  
Transform the document through this JSON filter before writing: a program that reads the document as JSON on stdin, receives the output format name as its argument, and writes the transformed JSON on stdout. Repeatable; filters run in the order given

**--data-dir** *\<DIR\>*  
Search this directory for user data (filters in `filters/`, templates in `templates/`, syntax definitions in `syntax/`) before the built-in locations. Defaults to `$XDG_DATA_HOME/carta` (or `~/.local/share/carta`)

**-c**, **--css** *\<FILE\>*  
Style an EPUB with this stylesheet, embedded in the book and linked from every page in place of the built-in one. Repeatable; several sheets are linked in order

**--epub-cover-image** *\<FILE\>*  
Use this image as an EPUB's cover, generating a dedicated cover page

**--epub-embed-font** *\<FILE\>*  
Embed this font file in an EPUB. Repeatable

**--epub-metadata** *\<FILE\>*  
Merge Dublin Core metadata from this XML file into an EPUB's package document

**--epub-subdirectory** *\<DIRNAME\>*  
Hold an EPUB's content in this container subdirectory (default `EPUB`; empty for the archive root)

**--split-level** *\<N\>*  
Split the document into separate files at this heading level (EPUB). `--epub-chapter-level` is an accepted alias

**--reference-doc** *\<FILE\>*  
Style a DOCX from this reference document: its styling parts and document template are reused, and the converted content is generated into it

**--highlight-style** *\<STYLE\|FILE\>*  
Colorize code blocks with this style: a built-in name (`--list-highlight-styles`) or a JSON theme file. Overrides the style selected by `--syntax-highlighting`

**--no-highlight**\[=*\<NO_HIGHLIGHT\>*\] \[default: false\]  
Leave code blocks unhighlighted (equivalent to `--syntax-highlighting=none`)\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--syntax-highlighting** *\<none\|default\|idiomatic\|STYLE\|FILE\>*  
How code blocks are presented: `default` uses the target's default, `none` leaves them plain, `idiomatic` uses the target format's own listing construct, and any other value names a built-in style or a JSON theme file to colorize with

**--syntax-definition** *\<FILE\>*  
Load an additional syntax definition (a KDE-syntax XML file) whose language joins the catalog, overriding a built-in of the same name. Repeatable

**--list-highlight-languages**\[=*\<LIST_HIGHLIGHT_LANGUAGES\>*\] \[default: false\]  
List the languages this build can highlight and exit\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--list-highlight-styles**\[=*\<LIST_HIGHLIGHT_STYLES\>*\] \[default: false\]  
List the built-in highlight styles and exit\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--print-highlight-style** *\<STYLE\|FILE\>*  
Print a highlight style (a built-in name or a theme file) as a JSON theme and exit

**--list-input-formats**\[=*\<LIST_INPUT_FORMATS\>*\] \[default: false\]  
List the input formats this build supports and exit\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--list-output-formats**\[=*\<LIST_OUTPUT_FORMATS\>*\] \[default: false\]  
List the output formats this build supports and exit\

\
*Possible values:*

- true

- false

**--list-extensions**\[=*\<FORMAT\>*\]  
List extensions and their default state for FORMAT (the Markdown dialect if omitted) and exit

**-D**, **--print-default-template** *\<FORMAT\>*  
Print the built-in default template for FORMAT and exit

**--version**  
Print version information and exit

**-d**, **--defaults** *\<FILE\>*  
Read conversion options from a YAML defaults file. Repeatable; later options take priority

**-h**, **--help**  
Print help

\[*INPUT*\]  
Read these files in order, with blank lines between text inputs. Use - for stdin
